subject: The AI shift turning cold leads into clients
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most cold leads don't go cold because they were never interested.


They go cold because nobody got back to them fast enough.


Here's the reframe.


The old way: a lead fills out a form, sits in an inbox for a day, then gets a generic follow‑up.


The AI Growth Engine way: it's contacted within minutes, qualified automatically, and routed straight onto your calendar.


One independent service business we looked at was sitting on a list of leads nobody had touched in months.


They didn't buy more leads.


They plugged in an AI follow‑up sequence — fast, consistent messages, nothing fancy.


Old leads started replying.


A few turned into booked calls.


A few of those turned into paying clients.


Not magic.


Just speed and consistency, automated.


Quick qualifier: this works best if you're already generating leads but losing them to slow follow‑up.


If lead volume itself is the problem, this isn't the fix — skip this one.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}?


Book a quick discovery call and I'll walk you through how The AI Growth Engine would work for you — grab a time here.


Talk soon,


Dylan | Digigrowth


P.S. — this isn't a sales pitch, just 20 minutes to see if this is a fit for how you already generate leads.
